$comment: Outputs of upstream `categorizeBulkWriteRows` (src/rx-storage-helper.ts:205) for generated write sequences against the real in-memory storage instance state (PLAN.md 4.3 and 7.2). Both sides of a write are recorded: the rows to persist and the change events to emit, including the INSERT-for-revived-document and 409-conflict cases.

determinism.mathRandom: xorshift128 seeded with 0x5eed1e55, 1 draw per call
determinism.dateNow: frozen monotonic clock starting at 1700000000000, +1 ms per call
determinism.eventBulkId: randomToken(10) output, deterministic because Math.random is seeded
determinism.context: echoed from the caller, not generated
